kept.spine: Nothing about Spitzplatz marks it out in either direction. The road holds up, the market keeps its stalls, and the town is neither building nor selling off what it has.

kept.spine: Ask what the town lives on, and the answer comes back as a list, not a single trade.

kept.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
kept.spine: Goods off the road and goods made in Spitzplatz share the same market stalls, and nothing there marks one from the other.
Something is always going out of the town. Let one trade go quiet, and another is still moving.
Spitzplatz is not hungry, and it has nothing set aside against a bad turn.
